STEP 1 - Scene: A salad-and-potato plate, likely a café lunch: roasted herbed potato wedges, bulgur/couscous salad with roasted peppers, red onion and cucumber, a dollop of white sauce (yogurt or cheese-like), and a mixed leaf salad with red leaves and lettuce. Photographed from above at a slight angle.

STEP 2 - Ruler: Square white plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 530 cm² (treating the visible plate as ~26 cm square-ish dinner plate). A fork is visible at the left edge, consistent with ~19 cm length.

STEP 3 - Items: roasted potato wedges; bulgur/couscous salad with pepper, onion, cucumber; mixed leaves (red and green); white dollop sauce; a little grated yellow garnish (lemon zest or similar).

- Bulgur salad with vegetables: 20% (~106 cm²)
- Mixed leaves: 30% (~159 cm²)

Total ≈ 85% covered.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Potatoes, roasted with a little oil: ~130 kcal/100 g → 363 kcal
- Bulgur salad with olive oil dressing: ~110 kcal/100 g → 105 kcal
- Mixed leaves: ~20 kcal/100 g → 14 kcal
- White sauce (yogurt-style): ~100 kcal/100 g → 16 kcal
- Garnish: ~30 kcal/100 g → 1 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 465 g and ≈ 499 kcal. For a plate ~85% covered with a substantial potato portion, this is plausible for a single café lunch plate.

Estimated total: about 465 g, about 500 kcal.
